description: Equipment, workplace, access, and people requests for a mid-size organization.

policies.title: Computing equipment
policies.text: Laptops, monitors, docking stations, keyboards, headsets, tablets and other computing peripherals route to IT Services (IT). Use High priority only when the requester cannot work without the item.

policies.title: Software and business application access
policies.text: Software licences, SaaS subscriptions, cloud storage, and access to business applications such as CRM or booking systems route to IT Services (IT).

policies.title: Workplace and building services
policies.text: Desks, chairs, projectors, meeting rooms, building access badges, parking, cleaning and repairs route to Facilities (FAC).

policies.title: Spend threshold
policies.text: Any request with an estimated cost above 5,000 must route to Finance (FIN) for budget review.

policies.title: People changes
policies.text: Onboarding, offboarding, role changes and training requests route to People (HR).

policies.title: Safety first
policies.text: Any reported safety hazard, such as exposed wiring, a water leak, or a blocked exit, is Urgent and routes to Facilities (FAC) regardless of category.

policies.title: Unclear requests
policies.text: When a request lacks the information needed to determine the owning department, keep its current department, mark it for human review, and ask one clarifying question.

policies.title: Human approval
policies.text: Triage recommendations are advisory. Only an authorized approver may approve or reject a request. A recommendation must never state or imply that a request is approved.
